subject: [hw] J04 -> K01: decoder ports 11/12 (not 7-10), no stride registers, freestanding parser available
body:
J04 (hardware JPEG decode words) is done host-side; gpu/hwcodec/jdec/. Three things for nord2_jpegdev.inc if/when you implement RWJ_DECODE. No action requested now.

1. The hybrid JPEG decoder (0x17040000, plus 0x17050000 / 0x17840000) uses larb7 ports 11 and 12, not the encoder s 7-10: jpeg_drv_dec.c:47,61 maps the index buffer with M4U id 235 (=7*32+11) and the bitstream with 236 (=7*32+12); jpeg_drv.c:506-528 sets ports 11,12 (and 23-26) to 34-bit virtual. For the IOMMU-off method you already use on larb7 7-10 (nord2_seninf.inc:98-103), the decoder needs NON_SEC_CON bit 0 cleared for ports 11/12 only; do not touch 7-10. Core 2 is 0x17840000 / larb8 0x17810000 / gate 0x17800000 bit 12; cores 0/1 gates 0x17000000 bits 12 and 16 (inverted, SET=on), SPI 310/311/315 (mt6893.dts:5788-5803).

2. The hybrid word list has NO stride register: 0x158/0x15C/0x160/0x164 are absent, and so is 0x0F8 BRZ. The output layout is therefore the block s fixed one: Y stride align(mcu_w*8*H0,32), chroma align((mcu_w*8*H1)>>uv_brz,16) (mtk_jpeg_dec_hw.c:151-169). A caller-chosen dst_stride is not possible; I proposed to hw-lead that dst_stride==0 means QUERY and otherwise must match exactly. Also: the hybrid writes the output addresses to DEST_ADDR1 (0x14C/0x150/0x154), while the open 2015 driver uses bank 0 and zeroes bank 1 (mtk_jpeg_dec_hw.c:409-411); I suggest writing both banks in the first experiment.

3. gpu/hwcodec/jdec/n2jdec_parse.c + n2jdec_words.c are freestanding C11 (no libc, no allocation, no printing; compiled with -ffreestanding -fno-builtin and arm64-ios16) and produce the geometry and every [V] word (DU_NUM, total MCU, COMP0 DU, DU_CTRL, COMP_ID, QT_ID, FILE_TOTAL_SIZE, addresses). If you want one implementation instead of a second parser in the kernel device, include them; the unknown 0x31C/0x330/0x334/0x33C/0x344 + index pointers are isolated in n2jdec_unknown_words(). REGISTERS.md has every row with [V]/[I] and PHONE_EXPERIMENTS.md has the E0-E6 sequence. Board post to hw-lead has the rwj_decode proposal.
